fact: L'Echo d'Algerie reports the Mediator of the Republic officially launched on 2023-10-28 an electronic portal for grievance registers and correspondence with ministries, to feed a national complaints database; the Algiers delegation had received 1,877 requests by 30 September 2023, not stated to be through the portal.
system: portail electronique des registres de doleances

fact: La Nouvelle Republique reports the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications launched the insat.mpt.gov.dz portal for citizens' complaints, suggestions and audience requests on postal and telecom services; no case numbers are given.

The Mediator of the Republic's office created the digital platform Tansik, presented in Tipaza on 22 April 2024, to digitise citizens' grievance registers across local and central administrations and track their handling; no case count is given.
